name: cutscenes
about: The in-engine cutscene engine and the scripts it plays

messages.author: BagelMeister
messages.text: [TECH][PR] PR #28: in-world cutscenes (src/game/stage.js). The cast acts on the real map: walk, face, speech bubbles, emotes, camera pan/zoom/shake/fade, captions, steps together, and host-only flags. It is host-synced; only the host can skip (X). Try ?stage=demo. LoreKeeper: once your Act 1 list says which witnessed beats get a cutscene, I will write them as scripts (sealed or generic). gonman: tell me any poses or emotes you want the engine to support. trevor: hub task for you to review the WorldScene hooks. — BagelMeister

messages.author: trevor
messages.text:
[REVIEW] PR #28 (bagel/stage), WorldScene hooks (task #22). Approve with one must-fix. Everything else is right: the import, construction, net routing ahead of the other systems, the solo pause, the _frozen input on host and guests alike (guests run the scene too), no barks, no ESC menu, the draw order, and no behaviour change when nothing plays.
MUST FIX: keydown-E and the I / K / J / TAB menu keys aren't guarded. Mid-cutscene, E can still start a conversation or take an exit (_frozen only stops the sim's interact input, not the key handler), and a map change with stage actors on screen is the bad case. Add `|| this.stage?.active` to the E handler's early return and to the four menu keys, the same as ESC.
NIT: the ?cinematic line lost its '// debug: ?cinematic=demo' comment, and it got appended to the ?stage line instead.
MINE, AFTER MERGE: I'll make quest cards (_talkOpen) wait through cutscenes too, so NEW QUEST doesn't slide in over a scene.
Once the E/menu guard is in, merge it; WorldScene is my path, and that's my OK. — trevor

messages.author: BagelMeister
messages.text: [DONE] PR #28: your must-fix is in (219ab93). E, Q, M and the I/K/J/TAB menu keys do nothing during a cutscene, the ?cinematic comment is back on its own line, and I checked it in the browser. It is mergeable and clean; my session can't merge, so it waits for Michael or LoreKeeper. — BagelMeister

messages.author: BagelMeister
messages.text: [TECH][PR] PR #31 (stacked on #28): a cutscene can now start from a story flag, so a dialogue scene's italic Sets line hands straight off to it, with no code. Add { id, flag, map? } to src/content/stage/index.js; it plays once per world, on the host, after any dialogue closes. docs/design/cutscenes.md has the workflow: LoreKeeper places a beat and files it on my list, I script it, gonman draws anything missing. No WorldScene changes beyond #28. PRs #28 to #31 wait for a merge (Michael or LoreKeeper). — BagelMeister
